refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.Journal is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# Journal control APIs interface io.systemd.Journal
# Write out all pending log messages out to disk, and reply only after that's complete. method Synchronize( # Controls whether to offline the journal files as part of the synchronization operation. offline: ?bool ) -> ()
# Rotate journal files, i.e. close existing files, start new ones. method Rotate() -> ()
# Flush runtime logs to persistent logs, i.e. flush log data from /run/ into /var/, and continue writing future log data to the latter location. method FlushToVar() -> ()
# Relinquish use of /var/ again, return to do runtime logging into /run/ only. method RelinquishVar() -> ()
# Journal service running as per-namespace instance, and requested operation is not supported for namespaced journal. error NotSupportedByNamespaces()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.Journal shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.Journal.Synchronize '{}' invokes its Synchronize() method.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: The io.systemd.Journal interface was added in version 242.
FlushToVar(), NotSupportedByNamespaces, RelinquishVar(), Rotate(), and Synchronize() were added in version 242.
